We are seeking instructors, scholars, and community-engaged researchers for Princeton University's new program in Design. Based in Keller Center for Innovation in Engineering Education, these programs include instruction in HCI, co-design, participatory design, and community-based innovations. The following positions are available: please read the full descriptions and apply by JULY 31 2026.

Postdoc in Design for Societal Impact<

>, a 1-2 year research and teaching position for recent PhD's in design research, including systems design, critical design, responsible/ethical design, research through design, HCI, STS, design anthropology, architecture, and related fields.

>, an expert in co-design, design justice, participatory and/or community-centered design. This year-round role will teach advanced theories and methods in design while contributing to our community-based design courses, summer extensions, and student capstone projects.

>, a credentialed professional with advanced experience in design who is passionate about introducing newcomers to the basics, this role will teach our introductory design class, open to students across campus.
